description:
TailnetCertVerifier accepts any certificate (returns ServerCertVerified::assertion() unconditionally). This is intentional — Tailscale WireGuard provides authentication, TLS is for confidentiality only.

Issues:
1. Duplicated: defined in both kithd/src/discovery.rs and kith-peer/src/lib.rs
2. Call sites lack safety comments explaining why cert validation is skipped
3. Trust model not in SECURITY.md

Fix:
- Move TailnetCertVerifier to kith-core or kith-tslocal, export once
- Add // Safety: Tailscale WireGuard identity — see TailnetCertVerifier doc at each construction site
- Add SECURITY.md section documenting the trust model and preconditions
title: TailnetCertVerifier: deduplicate, add safety notes at call sites, document trust model
